title: Remove Icon Dependencies
description: Remove Lucide npm packages and make UI icon codegen read only committed SVGs under ui/asset/icon/. Clean stale lucide-react references.
summary: Removed Lucide npm packages (`lucide`, `lucide-static`) and refactored `ui/asset/script.ts` to codegen icon bindings directly from committed SVGs under `ui/asset/icon/` — no node_modules vendor step. Renamed `normalizeLucideSvg` to `normalizeCatalogSvg`, removed `VENDORED_ICON_IDS` and `vendorIcons`, and updated README generation for the new in-repo workflow. Cleaned stale `lucide-react` references from Coda Vite optimizeDeps and repo CLI dependency allowlists. Verified `bun install`, `bun nx run @semio-tech/ui-asset:build`, and 154-icon catalog generation succeed without any icon npm packages.
